standard.summary: （实验性）per-sigma-bin 的自适应 loss 采样器：维护每个噪声 sigma 区间的历史 loss EMA，用多项式分布代替均匀时间步采样，重点训练 loss 最高（最难）的 sigma 区间。
standard.effect: 优化时间步的采样效率：sigma 区间 loss 高（模型在该区间表现差）→ 增加采样该区间的概率。动态适应训练状态，比固定权重方案更智能。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。与 anima_weighting_scheme 正交（一个控制 loss 权重，一个控制采样分布），可以叠加使用。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。EMA 需要一定步数积累才能反映真实 loss 分布，短训练（<100步）效果不明显。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) A per-sigma-bin adaptive loss sampler: it keeps an EMA of historical loss for each noise sigma bin and replaces uniform timestep sampling with a multinomial draw, concentrating training on the bins with the highest (hardest) loss.
standard_en.effect: Makes timestep sampling more efficient: a sigma bin with high loss (where the model does badly) gets a higher chance of being sampled. It adapts to the state of the run, which is smarter than a fixed weighting scheme.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. It is orthogonal to anima_weighting_scheme (one sets loss weights, the other the sampling distribution), so the two can be stacked.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. The EMA needs a number of steps before it reflects the true loss distribution, so the effect is faint in short runs (<100 steps).

advanced.principle: 将 sigma 空间分为 ant_loss_sampler_bins 个区间，维护各区间的 loss EMA（指数滑动平均，系数 ant_loss_sampler_alpha）。采样时以多项式分布按 loss EMA 值采样（高 loss 区间高概率）。beta_schedule 控制 EMA 更新的学习率衰减，防止后期对早期噪声信号过度敏感。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 anima_weighting_scheme 同时使用时需要注意：weighting_scheme 改变各步的 loss 权重（梯度幅度），而 loss_sampler 改变哪些步骤被选中（采样频率）；两者叠加效果复杂，建议分开测试。

advanced_en.principle: Divides sigma space into ant_loss_sampler_bins intervals and maintains a loss EMA per interval (coefficient ant_loss_sampler_alpha). Sampling uses a multinomial distribution weighted by loss EMA (high-loss intervals sampled more often). beta_schedule decays the EMA update's learning rate, preventing late-training oversensitivity to early noise signals.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Careful when combined with anima_weighting_scheme: weighting_scheme changes per-step loss weights (gradient magnitude), while loss_sampler changes which steps get selected (sampling frequency); their combined effect is complex — test them separately.
